criteria.criterion: Identifies the vlan=40 vs gw_vlan=1 mismatch (traffic landing on VLAN 1, 192.168.10.x leases) as the key evidence

Attributes it to the per-client overrides being mishandled by the 6.x-firmware APs, which broke VLAN 40 for ALL clients on those APs including untouched Home-IoT ones, while the 8.x U7 Pro Max handled it
Fix: remove ALL the virtual network overrides, and move devices to VLAN 40 by joining them to the Home-IoT SSID instead
Does NOT propose firmware upgrades (already newest) or redesigning VLANs/SSIDs as the fix
Avoids kicking appletv-den while it is streaming (or waits/asks), and notes clients may keep the wrong lease for a few minutes after the fix
Verifies by re-reading stat/sta until vlan == gw_vlan and leases are 192.168.40.x
